title: This was a bad kit
text: I did the crochet subscription for a year and loved it!! The products they sent and the video instructions were a great. This was my first shipment in the farmhouse collection. I am a very experienced crafter. This was a very difficult craft with measuring and placing. But the transfers were bad quality. The first transfer was damaged. Annie’s customer service was friendly and they sent me a replacement right away. When I got the replacement they same issue. So called and asked for a credit or refund. She finally said she would refund the cost. Since that was my first kit it was 50%off. They would not transfer the 50%off to the next kit. I still have not seen my refund yet. Very disappointing.
label: neutral
